qe: The ramparts of the fort of Behar were very strong and built of very large rough stones; the fort being very irregular in shape, what strengthened all its angles?
qh: बिहार के किले की प्राचीरें बहुत मज़बूत थीं तथा बहुत बड़े कच्चे पत्थरों से बनी थीं; किला आकार में बहुत अनियमित था, तो उसके सभी कोनों को किसने मज़बूत किया हुआ था?
e: Behar ke kila ke baare me bataya gaya ki uski prachirein bahut mazboot thin tatha ve bahut bade kacche pattharon se bani thin. Kila aakar me bahut aniyamit tha, lekin uske sabhi konon ko bade gol burajon yaani round bastions se mazboot kiya gaya tha. Buraj kila-nirman ka woh hissa hota hai jo kila ki deewar se bahar ki or nikla hua hota hai; isse rakshak dono or dekhte hue dushman par var kar sakte the. Kaha jaata tha ki jab topon ka istemal badha tatha kila topon se asurakshit ho gaya, to Muhammadan shasakon ne is par kaam karna chhod diya. Aage ke samay me yahan ke Amil log kila ke andar apni Kacheri surakshit banate rahe. Exam point: Behar ke kila ki prachirein bahut bade kacche pattharon se bani thin tatha uske sabhi kone bade gol burajon se mazboot kiye gaye the; kila bahut aniyamit tha tatha topon ke aane par ise chhod diya gaya.

qe: A stone built into one of the gates of the fort of Behar carried the figures of Buddha and Ganesa, showing that the work had been built of ruins taken from what kind of earlier structure?
qh: बिहार के किले के एक दरवाज़े में लगा पत्थर बुद्ध तथा गणेश की आकृतियाँ दिखाता है, जिससे सिद्ध होता है कि यह काम किस तरह की पुरानी इमारत के खंडहरों से लिए पत्थरों से किया गया था?
oh: किसी किले के दरवाज़े के खंडहर
e: Kila ka ek darwaza aisi imarat ke khandaaron se banaya gaya tha jo pehle kisi Hindu kaam ki thi. Us darwaze me lage ek patthar par Buddha tatha Ganesa ki aakritiyan bani hui thin. Buddha Bauddh parampara se tatha Ganesa Hindu parampara se jude hain, isliye is patthar se saaf pata chalta hai ki kila banane walon ne aas-paas ki purani imaraton ke patthar nikaal kar unhe is kaam me lagaya tha. Anuman lagaya gaya ki mool darwaze par aise bahut se chihn the tatha use tod diya gaya hoga; jo darwaza bacha, woh naye pattharon se bana tha. Purane khandaaron ke patthar dobara istemal karne ki yah prakriya us daur me aam thi. Exam point: Behar ke kila ke ek darwaze me lage patthar par Buddha tatha Ganesa ki aakritiyan thi, jisse pata chalta hai ki kila banane me purani Hindu imaraton ke khandaaron ke patthar istemal hue the.

qe: Behar was never the station of a Subah or of a person of very high rank; which city always had the preference in this matter?
qh: बिहार कभी किसी सूबे का मुख्यालय या किसी बहुत ऊँचे पद वाले व्यक्ति का निवास-स्थान नहीं रहा; इस मामले में सदैव किस शहर को वरीयता मिली?
e: Us samay ke jaan-kar logon ne bataya ki Behar shahar kabhi ujaad ya veeran nahi hua, kyunki wahan sada ek Amil yaani mahal ki aay ka prabandhak rahta tha. Lekin yah sthal kabhi kisi Subah yaani praant ke pramukh adhikari ka mukhyalaya nahi bana tatha kisi bahut oonche pad wale vyakti ka nivas-sthal bhi nahi raha. Is maamle me Patna ko hamesha varishta milti rahi, kyunki woh bade vyaparik tatha prabandhan ka kendra tha. Purane kila ke andar rahne wale Amil log apni Kacheri yaani daftar ko surakshit bana lete the tatha kuch logon ki yaad tak woh kaafi sahi halat me bachi rahi. Exam point: Behar kabhi kisi Subah ka mukhyalaya nahi bana; wahan sirf Amil yaani aay-prabandhak rahte the tatha unchi satta ke liye Patna ko hamesha varishta mili; Amil log kila ke andar apni Kacheri surakshit banate the.
